Satoyama Treasure Hunter!! ~ Make a wreath from natural materials

Hanno Ecotourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-morimana-treasurehunter/

An interactive eco-tour where you search for treasures in nature while learning about the connections in living ecosystems and the appeal of satoyama (traditional rural landscapes) together with specialist students.

【Fee】
Adult: ¥2,500
Student: ¥1,500
Preschool child: ¥1,000
(Includes guide, insurance, materials, and food)

【Capacity】20 people

【Guide】Mori no Field Gakusha (Forest Field Academy) staff

【What to bring】Gloves, drink, lunch, change of clothes, insect repellent if needed

【More information】Mori no Field Gakusha website: https://morinomanabiya168.wixsite.com/website
